documents.title: Northforge supplier record
documents.text: Northforge Components is an approved industrial valve supplier. Supplier S-104 supplies Valve-742 for the East Plant.

documents.title: Valve-742 installation
documents.text: Valve-742 is installed in Pump-3 at East Plant. The replacement valve is compatible with the PX-4 pump assembly.

documents.title: Pump-3 service plan
documents.text: Maintenance Plan MP-9 covers Pump-3. A maintenance task was postponed pending arrival of the Valve-742 replacement.

documents.title: Pump-3 maintenance approval
documents.text: Approval APR-81 delayed Pump-3 service after the valve shipment missed the agreed delivery window. Engineer sign-off required.

documents.title: East Plant component register
documents.text: East Plant operates Pump-3 and Sensor-17. Component replacement impact requires asset owner review.

documents.title: Customer 360 data product
documents.text: Customer 360 is a governed data product. The Data Governance team is its owner and steward.

documents.title: Customer 360 source lineage
documents.text: Customer 360 consumes CRM Accounts and ERP Parties datasets. The CRM is the system of record for contact preferences.

documents.title: CRM Accounts catalog entry
documents.text: CRM Accounts dataset is produced by the Customer Platform application and feeds Customer 360. Its catalog owner is CRM Operations.

documents.title: ERP Parties metadata
documents.text: ERP Parties is an ERP source dataset containing supplier and customer party master identifiers. It contributes to Customer 360.

documents.title: Data product access policy
documents.text: Access to restricted data products requires an approved purpose, group-based permissions, and a current owner approval.

documents.title: Audit control for data access
documents.text: Every restricted data product access decision records requester, purpose, approver, policy version and expiry.

documents.title: Reference-data status scheme
documents.text: Party status is governed as a controlled vocabulary. Code ACT means Active and code INA means Inactive or deactivated.

documents.title: Customer status mapping
documents.text: The CRM value DISABLED maps to approved Party Status code INA. Mapping owner is Data Governance.

documents.title: Supplier risk register
documents.text: Northforge risk status was put under review after two late shipments. Vendor Risk Office owns the risk review.

documents.title: Supplier contract metadata
documents.text: The Northforge Components supply contract for Valve-742 contains replacement lead-time commitments and escalation policy.

documents.title: Vendor risk oversight
documents.text: Vendor Risk Office monitors repeated supplier delays. A risk flag does not automatically mean the supplier is deactivated.

documents.title: Graph query design for dependencies
documents.text: Dependency impact is traced by supplier supplies component, component installedIn asset, and asset governedBy maintenance plan.

documents.title: Vector index engineering note
documents.text: Enterprise search indexes document chunks with vector dimensions, model versions and document-level access controls.

documents.title: Hybrid retrieval architecture
documents.text: Hybrid search combines BM25 keyword ranking and TF-IDF or neural vector ranking using reciprocal rank fusion. A reranker is optional.

documents.title: Context graph decision memory
documents.text: A decision graph links an action to actor, evidence snapshot, applicable policy version, and recorded time.

documents.title: Graph provenance contract
documents.text: Each extracted graph relation must link to the source document and its revision, so downstream explanations are auditable.

documents.title: Incident 917 critical alert
documents.text: Incident INC-917 reported pressure anomalies for Sensor-17. The alert requires on-call engineer triage.

documents.title: Document access restrictions
documents.text: Viewer access allows only public documents. Engineers may read engineering records; stewards may additionally inspect approval and risk records.

documents.title: Source freshness and stale index
documents.text: The supplier-risk index checkpoint was recorded before the latest ERP update. Results must show source and ingestion timestamps.

documents.title: GraphRAG corpus-level summary
documents.text: GraphRAG local search resolves entities and expands relevant text; global search can summarize detected communities across a corpus.

documents.title: Policy override temporal context
documents.text: An emergency purchasing exception expires on the next review date. Approvals must be rechecked against valid time.

documents.title: Customer 360 validation policy
documents.text: Customer 360 publication requires a named steward, lineage evidence and documented quality checks before release.

documents.title: Asset dependency semantic model
documents.text: The maintenance ontology defines Supplier, Component, Machine, Site and MaintenancePlan classes with typed property paths.

queries.q: Which assets depend on Northforge Valve-742?
queries.explain: Multi-hop dependency across supplier, component and maintenance plan.

queries.q: Who owns Customer 360 and which source datasets feed it?
queries.explain: Catalog ownership and source lineage require compatible entity identifiers.

queries.q: How is data product access approved and audited?
queries.explain: Keyword precision and policy citations; steward-only decisions must remain restricted.

queries.q: Which reference code means deactivated customer?
queries.explain: Exact approved code INA, including a synonym and a local-to-approved mapping.
Answer requires engineering context plus approval evidence unavailable to viewers.

queries.q: What is the latest risk on Northforge supplier?
queries.explain: A current risk claim requires freshness and role-based access to risk records.
